description: Wears 01. Reproduction; no construction number recorded. Open-air memorial to the air defenders of Murmansk on the west shore of the Kola Bay, free access. The site also carries S-75, S-125 and S-200 surface-to-air missile launchers, not listed here. Data from the russianplanes.net museum register (museum 40).
